verdict.rationale: Obsidian's core Daily notes plugin opens today's dated note or creates it if it doesn't exist, and can file daily notes into date-based folders. The core Templates plugin supports template variables, but the evidence never states that daily notes are pre-filled from a template or that the daily note opens automatically as the default landing page. Missing for 10: documented daily-note template setting, open-on-startup / default landing behavior, independent hands-on corroboration of the full workflow.

support.subject: As a power-user, I get an automatic daily note for each day, pre-filled from a template, as the default landing place for journaling and capture

citations.quote: Daily notes is a core plugin that opens a note based on today's date, or creates it if it doesn't exist.
You can automatically organize your daily notes into folders using the Date format feature.
You can add dynamic information to your templates, using template variables.
